conventions.fit_model: c_fit ln(x) + constant + sum_j a_j/x^j; unweighted, column-scaled SVD
conventions.baseline_limit: L<=144, lower bound24 for m4 else18, inverse order1
conventions.scale_screen: theta/L<=0.05 is recorded as an operational screen, not proof of a scaling limit
conventions.no_target_selection: Neither the equilibrium fit nor any literature value selects windows, models or candidate rankings
conventions.old_pass_flags: retained solely as historical provenance; not used for any current diagnostic
conventions.reachability: source rank/ground metadata, consistently checked across available sources; this inventory does not repeat Bloch rank calculations
conventions.blocked: Inf is the accessible excited-state limit; its fitted parameter is not a ground-state corner coefficient
conventions.duplicate_policy: equal raw points pooled once after checking S_A,S_C,S_B,D within1e-8; no independent-sample interpretation
conventions.uncertainty: model/window variation and condition/noise gain are deterministic diagnostics, never statistical CI
conventions.evidence_limit: finite-window fit agreement does not establish asymptotic log scaling; continuous-time size platforms remain to be tested

inventory.caution: Existing grids differ; raw slopes precede fits. Model/window ranges are sensitivity, not statistical confidence intervals. No equilibrium target used in selection.
